lines.text: AMC eight challenge! Think it's twelve? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 8 challenge! Think it's 12? Nope!

lines.text: The medians of triangle A B C meet at G. Side B C is twenty-four.
lines.caption: The medians of triangle ABC meet at G. Side BC is 24.

lines.text: E F runs through G, parallel to B C. How long is E F?
lines.caption: EF runs through G, parallel to BC. How long is EF?

lines.text: G is two thirds of the way down each median, from A.
lines.caption: G is 2/3 of the way down each median, from A.

lines.text: Now shrink the triangle toward A, until B C lands on E F.
lines.caption: Now shrink the triangle toward A, until BC lands on EF.

lines.text: The middle of B C slides up the median, and lands right on G.
lines.caption: The middle of BC slides up the median, and lands right on G.

lines.text: So every length shrinks to two thirds.
lines.caption: So every length shrinks to 2/3.

lines.text: Two thirds of twenty-four is sixteen!
lines.caption: 2/3 of 24 is 16!

lines.text: Twelve was the trap. That's halfway down, not two thirds.
lines.caption: 12 was the trap. That's halfway down, not 2/3.

lines.text: Did you get sixteen? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 16? Tell me below!
